• **Professional Squash Association (PSA)**

 
 
• The PSA is the global governing body for professional squash, organizing tournaments and rankings.
 
• It manages the PSA World Tour, which includes a range of events from Bronze to Platinum levels, based on prize money and player participation.
 
• PSA promotes the growth of squash through international competitions and player development.
 
 
 
• **Squash in India**
 
 
• Squash is governed in India by the Squash Rackets Federation of India (SRFI).
 
• India has produced several notable squash players, including Joshna Chinappa, Dipika Pallikal, and Saurav Ghosal.
 
• National and international tournaments, like the Indian Open, play a key role in promoting the sport in the country.
 
 
 
• **Squash Scoring System**
 
 
• Modern squash matches are typically played using the Point-A-Rally (PAR) scoring system.
 
• Each match consists of best-of-five games, with players earning points on every rally.
 
• The first player to reach 11 points wins the game, provided they have a lead of at least two points.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Playing Squash**
 
 
• Squash is a high-intensity sport that improves cardiovascular fitness and agility.
 
• It enhances hand-eye coordination and reflexes, making it a great choice for athletes.
 
• Playing squash also helps in stress relief and mental focus due to its fast-paced nature.
